spans.s:
(ऋ) मिथृ r. 1st cl. (मिथति-ते)
1 To understand.
2 To injure, to hurt.
3 To unite, to pair.

ind.
1 Mutually, reciprocally.
2 Privately.
E.
मिथ to pair, aff. असुन्, and the vowel unchanged.

f. (-ला)
A city, giving name also to a kingdom, lying north-east of Bengal, the modern Tirhut.
E.
मिथ to be agitated, (enemies by that kingdom,) and इलच् Uṇādi aff.

n. (-नं)
1 A couple, a pair, a brace, male and female.
2

Copulation.
3

Union, junction.
m. (-नः)
The sign of the zodiac Gemini.
E.
मिथ to unite, उनन् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-वः)
Amorous inclination.
E.
मिथुन, and भाव property, च्चि aff.

ind.
Falsely, untruly.
E.
मिथ to injure, deriv. irr.

mfn. (-रन्-रन्ती-रत्)
Acting or practising falsehood.
E.
मिथ्या, and आचरत् observing.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Acting falsely.
E.
मिथ्या, and आचार observance.

f. (-ष्टिः)
Denial of future existence, atheism, heresy.
E.
मिथ्या falsely, and दृष्टि vision, knowledge.

f. (-तिः)
A figure of rhetoric, confirmation of one error or impossibility by another.
E.
मिथ्या falsehood, अध्यवसिति perseverance.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
Treacherous, guilty of a breach of promise.
E.
मिथ्या, and प्रतिज्ञा promise.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
Pretendedly asleep, but not so in reality.
E.
मिथ्या, and प्रसुप्त asleep.

m. (-गः)
Groundless plaint or demand.
E.
मिथ्या falsely, अभियोग plaint.

n. (-नं)
A false accusation.
E.
मिथ्या falsely, अभिशंसन accusing.

m. (-सी)
A false or unjust accuser.
E.
मिथ्या falsely, अभिशंसिन् who accuses.

f. (-तिः)
Error, ignorance, mistake.
E.
मिथ्या falsely, and मति understanding.

mfn. (-दन्-दन्ती-दत्)
Speaking falsely.
E.
मिथ्या, and वदत् speaking.

mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि)
Lying, a liar.
E.
मिथ्या, and वादिन् who speaks.

n. (-रं)
A false or prevaricating reply.
E.
मिथ्या, and उत्तर answer.

m. (-रः)
Pretended friendly services.
E.
मिथ्या, and उपचार assistance.
